title: Condition Rates Withheld from Marketplace Orders Replacement-Charge Refunds
content:
**Rates.** The condition rate of the Marketplace Orders replacement-charge refund follows the inspection recorded when the original unit was received at its destination: an original received damaged by the buyer keeps the buyer-damage rate of 0.5 (50%); one received used or incomplete keeps the incomplete rate of 0.25 (25%); any other inspection result keeps no condition rate.

The condition rate is withheld whatever the reason of the return the replacement was shipped against. The condition rate is added to any other rate the replacement-charge refund withholds; the combined rate, capped at the whole (one), is applied once to the refundable charge, giving the deductions, rounded half up to the cent; the deductions are subtracted from the refundable charge, and the refund never falls below zero.

| Inspection result at the received-at-destination scan | Condition rate |
|---|---|
| damaged by the buyer | 50% |
| used or incomplete | 25% |
| unopened, opened but resellable, or any other result | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

1. Refundable charge USD 48.60, an original received used or incomplete, and no other rate withheld: deductions 48.60 times 0.25, that is 12.15, so USD 12.15.
2. The same refund where another withheld rate of 16% also applies: combined rate 25% plus 16%, that is 41%; deductions 48.60 times 0.41, that is 19.926, rounded to USD 19.93.
3. An original received damaged by the buyer (50%) where another withheld rate of one also applies: the combined rate of 150% is capped at the whole, and the deductions equal the refundable charge.
